correctness.rationale: The reflection principle gives each conditional CDF. A faster positive-mass diffusivity subpopulation dominates at small time; Jensen with dominated convergence/Fatou gives the opposite sign at large time. Differentiating reduces the derivative sign to K(y)-c; every positive-y differentiated expectation is finite and K'' is strictly positive. Its two high endpoints and interior dip enforce exactly two simple density intersections and therefore one CDF crossing. Strict curvature in D and Jensen prove the support-dependent bracket. Exact symbolic derivatives and independent high-precision finite-law and divergent-negative-moment tests agree; the proof, not tests, establishes all-law scope.

value.rationale: A well-motivated physical crossover is shown to be unique for all finite-mean quenched diffusivity laws, ruling out multiple changes in efficiency; the two-extrema statement describes the complete difference profile. The strict support-only time bracket makes the root physically and numerically localizable. The theorem extends across infinite inverse-half-moment distributions, where common finite-moment long-time expansions fail. This is a structural universal result rather than a minor parameter-specific numerical improvement.
